obligations.statement: Pinned IANA tzdb wall-clock to UTC interval resolution (Core 01 TIME-PIN-1) is deterministic, admits only half-open UTC intervals [start, end) with start < end, refuses spring-forward gaps under every dst_policy and fall-back folds under dst_policy = reject, and preserves persisted UTC bounds across subsequent tzdb upgrades on replay.
obligations.owner: time foundation pack; Core 01 TIME-PIN-1 temporal materialization
assumptions: Each pinned tzdb version maps every local wall-clock instant to either a unique UTC instant, a spring-forward gap, or a fall-back fold with earlierUtc < laterUtc.
Committed records persist their resolved UTC bounds and temporal pins and replay them directly without re-evaluating wall-clock time under newer tzdb rules.
counterexamples: a wall-clock instant inside a spring-forward gap is admitted under earlier or later policy
an ambiguous fall-back fold instant is admitted under dst_policy = reject
a materialized interval has startUtc >= endUtc
a committed interval changes its UTC bounds on replay after a tzdb upgrade

obligations.statement: Every admitted published hr.Roster carries an accepted solver receipt digest, enforces a minimum rest floor no lower than the statutory baseline (e.g. Egypt 11h), admits only half-open UTC hr.ShiftCommitment intervals, and contains no overlapping shifts for the same employee (HR-SH-01), no shifts violating the minimum rest gap (HR-SH-03), and no shifts overlapping approved hr.LeaveRequest intervals (HR-SH-02).
obligations.owner: hr domain pack; loc-eg overlay; publish_roster commit check
assumptions: All shift commitments and approved leave requests are materialized to canonical half-open UTC intervals [startUtc, endUtc) before roster admission.
Roster publication and leave approval are serialized within one cell transaction against the active statutory labor profile.
counterexamples: two overlapping ShiftCommitments for the same employee are admitted in a published roster (HR-SH-01)
an employee is scheduled during an approved LeaveRequest (HR-SH-02)
a closing shift ending at 23:00 followed by a 06:00 opening shift (7h < 11h rest) is published (HR-SH-03)
a roster is published without a solver receipt digest or by silently relaxing the statutory minimum rest floor (HR-SH-04)
